task.title: Run the Level 2 hardened CIS workflow
task.shortdesc: Use the Level 2 fixture to review a stricter CIS profile before deployment.

prereq.p: Use fixture cis-workflow-level-2-release-fixture: Firefox Release 153, layer cis-l2.release-153, starter preset soc_hard, and comparison profile cis-workflow-level-1-release-reference.

context.p: Level 2 is the hardened path. It may be less compatible than Level 1, so the reviewer must inspect Guided and All settings, resolve attention items, compare against a Level 1 reference, export, and independently verify the result.

step.cmd: Create or duplicate a Release 153 profile, apply the SOC-style hardened starter preset, and apply the Level 2 CIS layer.

info.p: Expected result: the profile records soc_hard and cis-l2.release-153 in the source trail.

step.cmd: Review the profile in Guided editor, focusing on stricter security/privacy defaults and any controls that can affect usability, add-ons, browsing data, network behavior, or enterprise operations.

info.p: Expected result: high-impact settings are identified before the profile is exported.

step.cmd: Use All settings to filter configured CIS rows, open attention items, and trace each row to its generated recommendation topic, mapping table, UI target, and affected Firefox policy topic.

info.p: Expected result: every stricter value has a visible source path and a policy-topic route for review.

step.cmd: Resolve manual-review rows and intentional deviations using the deviation task, including owner, reason, review date, external record, and whether the value remains baseline, CIS, manual, imported, or raw.

info.note: BPM does not persist a dedicated exception or waiver object; preserve the external record before treating a deviation as reviewed.

step.cmd: Compare the Level 2 profile against the Level 1 reference fixture and inspect all changed or newly configured rows.

info.p: Expected result: the reviewer can explain why Level 2 differs from Level 1 before approval.

step.cmd: Validate, export policies.json, and run independent deployment verification with the owner-approved runtime, operating-system, network, or audit method.

info.p: Expected result: the hardened profile has an export artifact, validation result, comparison evidence, and external verification evidence.

result.p: The representative Level 2 hardened profile is reviewable end to end and remains bounded by BPM's mapping, export, and source-attribution evidence.

postreq.p: If independent verification finds deployment risk, keep the profile as a draft and update the external decision record before reuse.
